title: The Proof Is Out There: Unexplained Edition
description: Mysterious objects near the Moon, strange anomalies around Jupiter and a possible UFO from the Apollo 16 mission may be clues to something beyond our world; Tony Harris and his team investigate the evidence and deliver their verdict.

description: As winter gives way to spring, the Wild North becomes increasingly unpredictable; melting snow, treacherous terrain and a sudden whiteout force the mountain men to race the changing conditions before their windows of opportunity disappear.

title: Tales From Oak Island
description: In 1965, an article in Reader's Digest entitled "Oak Island's Mysterious Money Pit" inspires some of the great chapters in the world's long-running treasure hunt.

title: The Curse of Oak Island
description: In this riveting season finale, the Oak Island team make an astonishing revelation on Lot 8 and multiple treasured discoveries in the Money Pit area.

title: The Curse of Oak Island: Drilling Down
description: Matty Blake meets with the Oak Island team to look back on the most successful year yet in the 231-year-old treasure mystery.

title: The UnXplained
description: Throughout history, people have feared that ancient curses can bring misfortune, madness and even death to those who defy them; are these deadly warnings powered by supernatural forces or by the terrifying ability of belief itself to shape reality?

title: The UnXplained
description: Across the deserts of North Africa and the Near East--the region often called one of the Cradles of Civilization--entire armies, cities, and cultures have vanished beneath shifting sands. From a Persian force lost in the Great Sand Sea to buried Sumerian and Arabian cities that may have inspired enduring legends, new discoveries continue to challenge what we know about humanity's earliest empires, sacred stories, and ancient beliefs.

title: The UnXplained
description: From the eerie reports of spontaneous human combustion and the hunt for the Highgate Vampire, to the unsettling boogeymen known as the Men in Black appearing after UFO sightings, could these legends be more than just stories?

title: The UnXplained
description: Beneath our feet lie hidden ancient tunnels, sacred caves and shadowy passages into a world of darkness shaped by nature, carved by man and steeped in myth; seeing if the underground realms are mere remnants of the past, or they guard secrets.

title: The UnXplained Special Presentation
description: From the very founding of the United States, there have been many bizarre--and unsolved--mysteries that continue to capture our imagination. Did a divine encounter between George Washington and an angel influence a great victory in the American Revolution? What was the strange, green glow that seemed to heal wounded soldiers during the Civil War? And could America's most notorious assassin have led a double life... after death?

title: The UnXplained
description: During The Golden Age of Piracy, thousands of buccaneers terrorized the high seas and became legends; their exploits spawned stories of larger-than-life characters, billion dollar heists, and buried treasure that to this day, has never been found.

title: Hazardous History With Henry Winkler
description: Remember when playtime meant tempting fate?; from toy belts that fire speeding projectiles, to high-powered pogo sticks that send people soaring, to dolls that try to eat people alive, these playthings are made for kids, but their risks are anything but child's play; it's a mind-blowing, bone-rattling trip through the toys of yesteryear that remind people of a time when childhood was wild, free, and hazardous.

title: Hazardous History With Henry Winkler
description: Remember when people would do just about anything for an adrenaline fix? From racing cars at the "Murderdrome," to high diving on horseback, to cutting our teeth on looping water slides, revisit the ways people once chased a thrill. These death-defying stunts and gravity-pushing spectacles didn't always stick the landing, but that didn't stop anyone from trying. It's a heart-pumping jolt back to a time when a big rush was worth a little spill.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description: It's a treasure coveted by everyone from Roman emperors to Adolf Hitler; a sacred object said to hold incredible powers of healing, resurrection and immortality, the Holy Grail is the most sought-after relic in the world.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description: A city where the commute requires a zipline; a town crawling with monkeys; a waterfall of blood.

title: Secrets Declassified With David Duchovny
description: Before they become instruments of war, they sound like impossible ideas; an American medical student develops a closed-circuit rebreather that allows Allied frogmen to slip beneath enemy harbors without a single bubble, while U.S. Army engineers create a jeep-mounted nuclear launcher known as the "atomic watermelon"; across the Atlantic, an inventor pitches an aircraft carrier to hunt U-boats, carved from wood pulp and ice; because in war, today's absurdity can become tomorrow's secret weapon.

title: Forged in Fire
description: It's anchors aweigh, as four bladesmiths are tasked with forging a pirate's boarding axe from a treasure chest; two return to their home forges to re-create the legendary weapon carried by history's most notorious pirate.

title: The Food That Built America
description: In the late 1800s, two pharmacists 1500 miles apart race to create healthy, non-alcoholic beverage options, kickstarting the entire soda industry with their breakout hits: Hires Root Beer and Dr. Pepper.
